tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal sa skyar zhal gtor chen skabs zor las pa rim can nas sngon 'gro sgrub bsnyen gyi rten bla rdo bram gzugs kyi ri mo can gyi bzhugs khang zhing bkod tho// bzhugs khang steng du klu sgrub chos 'chad phyag rgya/ g.yas stod kyai rdor/ de 'og bek+tse gtso 'khor gsum mngon rtogs bzhin/ de 'og khrag mtsho'i dbus su pad nyi zla steng dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i steng glang po che la zhon pa'i li byin ha ra sku mdog sngon po dom slog gsol/ g.yas zhags nag g.yon spu gri/ dbu la dar nag gi theb zhwa gsol ba/ chibs sna mon nag gis khrid pa/ de g.yon yum shan+ti ro zan nag mo/ g.yas lcags kyu/ g.yon bhan+dha snying dmar gyis gang ba stag sham zhing lpags gsol ba/ gtso bo'i g.yas su seng dkar steng / pe dkar sku mdog dkar po ber smug dgu brtsegs dar nag gis thod bcings pa/ g.yas ru mtshon rtse gsum nag po/ g.yon zhags nag gtso bo'i mdun du srog bdag sku mdog dmar nag g.yas mdung dmar/ g.yon zhags dmar gyis dgra 'dzin pa/ aṃ gtsigs bsdoms shing bse khrab bse rmog gyon nas rta sngon la zhon pa/ de'i mdun du sku'i rgyal chen mon bu mthing nag g.yas rdo rje g.yon 'khar gsil/ maṇ+ḍi nag po'i gos gyon pa/ theb zhwa dmar po gyon zhing dom la zhon pa/ pe dkar gyi g.yas su gsung gi rgyal chen dgra lha skyes gcig nag po dar nag 'jol ber gsol ba/ g.yas sba mkhar g.yon tsan+dan gyi be con/ spyang sngon la zhon cing dbu skra gzings pa thod skam gyi dbu rgyan can/ gtso bo'i rgyab tu yon tan rgyal chen gnod sbyin nag po/ stag lhog g.yang gzhi gyon zhing sbrul rgyan can g.yas satwa gri/ g.yon zhags dmar gyis dgra bo 'khrid pa khyung khra la zhon pa/ shan+ti ro zan gyi g.yon du/ phrin las rgyal chen pe dkar zhal gsum phyag drug zhal dbus dkar/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar/ phyag g.yas gsum na lcags kyu/

mda'/ spu gri/ g.yon gsum na gri/ gzhu/ dbyug tho/ dar dkar gyi gos gyon pa stag chas bse theb gyon zhing seng ge zhon pa/ bzhugs khang g.yon stod du gur mgon lha brgyad 'byung 'dul bcas dkyus bzhin bri/ de 'og gza' bdud rā hu la/ de 'og rdor legs/ g.yas g.yon gyi gtso 'khor rnams kyi 'og thad nas brtsams te dmag dpon bzhi'i thad drang bshan pa nyer gcig tshan pa gnyis dang sgo ldeb la phyogs skyong bcu sogs tho nang bzhin rngam rngam 'jigs 'jigs gang che/ zhig gi bzhugs sgam phyi ma me ris thod skam sogs kyi ri mo gang mdzes rgyab la phrin bcol gyi yi ge bcas 'bri dgos rgyu/ ༈ gza' bdud rā hu la sku mdog dud kha lto ba man chad sbrul mjug phyag bzhi pa mgo dgu'i mdun brtsegs gsum dud kha g.yas brtsegs gsum dmar nag g.yon brtsegs gsum ljang nag de gsum gyi dbus na bya rog gi mgo bo kha gdangs pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum zhal thams cad gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ smin ma dang dbu skra gyen du brdzes pa lte ba nas khro zhal gdangs pa sbrul mjug ma gtogs sku lus mig gis gang ba/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po chu srin mgos tog byas pa'i rgyal mtshan 'phyar zhing / g.yon dang po sdigs mdzub la dkris pa'i sbrul zhags thugs kar 'phyangs ba 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ bya mgo ma gtogs dbu rnams la thod skam gsum mam lngas brgyan pa/ khrag mtsho'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i mdun du stag srin dkar mo stag gdong / g.yas na baṃ srin ser mo dred gdong / rgyab na rkang srin dmar mo glang gdong / g.yon na 'brog srin ljang nag chu srin gdong / thams cad g.yas zor ba 'phyar zhing / g.yon nad rkyal/ ༈ /yang khrag mtsho'i dbus su pad nyi ra skyes kham pa'i steng du rdor legs mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ spyan gsum khro tshul/ g.yas tho ba 'phyar ba/ g.yon dom lpags kyi sbud pa sku la dar nag ber can dgu brtsegs rin po che'i ske rags bcings pa'i mdun du rdo rje bod khams skyong sku mdog dkar mo nang gos dmar gyi ber ljang g.yas rdo rje g.yon zhags pa sha ba la zhon pa/

g.yas su rdo rje dpal gyi yum sku mdog dmar po nang gos ljang ser phyi ber dmar/ g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon lcags kyus mtshan pa'i dbyug tho/ dom nag la zhon pa/ g.yon du rdo rje g.yu bun ma sku mdog ser mo nang gos dmar gyi ber ljang / g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon ral gri stag la zhon pa/ mtha' bskor mdun du srog bdag dkar po g.yas ral gri rta ngang pa zhon pa/ g.yas su yum shud dmar po g.yas be con rta dmar zhon pa/ rgyab tu bdud ging nag po g.yas ral gri rta nag zhon pa/ g.yon du za byed sngon po spyang ki'i gdong g.yas dgra satwa/ g.yon zhags pa de bzhi ka g.yon rta srab 'dzin pa/ rang rang gi mdog mtshungs ber gyon pa/ skra gzings shing srin po'i cha lugs/ ༈ /yang rlung nag gseb tu dmag dpon stag zhon nag po phyag gnyis mdung 'dzin pa/ yang dred zhon sku mdog mthing nag g.yas ral gri/ g.yon zhags pa/ dmag dpon gzig zhon smug nag phyag gnyis rtse gsum dang / yang 'phar zhon dmar skya phyag gnyis mdung 'dzin pa/ 'di bzhi srin po'i cha lugs skra gzings shing lus gcer bu zhon pa'i steng na gnas pa/ gzhan yang mtha' skor ji ltar rigs par bdud 'dul dbang phyug dmar po/ g.yas ral gri g.yon spar ba gdengs pa/ sha za nag po g.yas spu gris g.yon gyi phyag mtshan ro'i mgo gcod pa/ khrag 'thung nag po lag gnyis mi bzung nas kha yis mjing rtsa 'jibs pa/ dam nyams dbugs len nag po mi bzung nas khang lag byed pa/ dgra bgegs gshegs po nag po g.yon pas mi'i skra nas bzung zhing g.yas gri 'debs pa/ chos byed srung ma nag po g.yas spu gri dang g.yon zhags pas mi bzung ba/ mna' zan gshegs po nag po lag gnyis mi bzung nas za ba/ ro zan nag po phyag gnyis ro bzung nas za ba/ sgyogs 'phen nag po lag gnyis lcags kyi sgyogs rdo dgra la 'phen pa/ nag po khrag 'jibs g.yas ral gri g.yon dgra snying 'don pa/ ro rdeb dmar po lag gnyis mi ro 'phyar nas brdeb pa/

srog gcod nag po g.yas ral gri dang g.yon ro gdan gyi rgyu ma 'don pa/ srog len smug nag g.yas rgyu zhags/ g.yon lcags kyu/ dbugs len nag mo sbrul rgyan can/ g.yas thod pa snying dang khrag gang / g.yon shang lang / ma mo khrag gdong nag mo lto ba khro zhal can/ g.yas thod khrag 'thung zhing / g.yon spar ba gdengs pa/ nad gtong nag mo g.yas nad rkyal/ g.yon gsal shing la mi ro btsugs pa/ bdud gcod nag mo g.yas spar ba gdengs shing g.yon mtshon cha'i 'khor lo g.yang gzhi gyon pa/ srog gcod nag po g.yas ral gri g.yon spar ba gdengs pa/ nad gtong rgyal mo nag mo g.yas nad rkyal/ g.yon mi ro gsal shing la btsugs pa sbrul rgyan can/ srog bdag nag mo lag gnyis mi ro brang la sbyar ba sbrul rgyan/ phrin las drag mo nag mo glang po la zhon pa g.yas mdung g.yon khrag 'phyar ba/ mngal srung nag po g.yas shang lang / g.yon spar ba gdengs pa/ 'di thams cad srin po'i cha lugs shin tu 'jigs tshul/ pho rnams stag sham mgo phreng rgyu zhags spyan gnyis pa/ thod skam gyi mgo rgyan/ mo rnams gcer bu sbrul rgyan rgyu ma'i ga shal spyan gnyis pa/ ༈ /yang 'gugs byed bshan pa nag po g.yas lcags kyu g.yon zhags pa/ 'ching byed bshan pa dmar po g.yas zhags pa g.yon thod khrag sgrog byed dud kha g.yas lcags sgrog g.yon mi mgo za ba/ 'bebs byed sngon po g.yas dril bu/ g.yon snying za ba/ gsod byed mthing nag g.yas ral gri g.yon thod khrag sgrol byed ljang gu g.yas shang lang / g.yon thod khrag dbugs len sngon po g.yas dbyug tho g.yon nad rkyal/ mdangs 'phrog nag po g.yas gri gug g.yon snying / khrag 'thung dmar po g.yas gri/ g.yon glo snying za ba/ dkrugs byed ljang gu g.yas spu gri/ g.yon phur pa/ srog bdud dmar po phyag gnyis mi ro phrag par khur ba/ khong khrag sngon po g.yas mi mgo g.yon glo snying / mna' zan nag po g.yas ral gri/ g.yon thod khrag

rig 'dzin srog shing dkar po mi ro za ba/ dgu bdud dmar nag g.yas gri gug g.yon thod khrag drag shul nag po g.yas ral gri g.yon zhags pa/ snying rings nag po g.yas tho ba g.yon skam pa/ bstan pa'i bshan pa ser po g.yas rgyu zhags g.yon mdung / srog len dmar nag g.yas rtse gsum g.yon zhags pa/ dug gdong nag po g.yas ral gri g.yon thod khrag 'phung byed nag po mi lus khyung mgo gshog pa can g.yas lcags kyu/ g.yon zhags pa/ thams cad kyang spyan gsum pa/ skra dmar nag gyen du brdzes shing thur du 'phyang ba/ dung long rus pa'i rgyan drug g.yang gzhi'i stod g.yogs stag gi sham thabs can rnams dang / sgo ldebs g.yas g.yon la/ tshangs pa gdong gcig ser po ngang pa la zhon pa/ phyag gnyis bum pa dang / brgya byin dkar po glang po zhon pa/ g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs mdzub/ me lha dmar po ra zhon pa g.yas phreng ba/ g.yon spyi blugs drang srong gi tshul/ gshin rje mthing nag ma he zhon pa g.yas dbyug pa/ srin po smug nag ro langs zhon pa/ g.yas ral gri/ chu lha dkar po chu srin zhon pa g.yas sbrul zhags/ rlung lha ljang gu sha ba la zhon pa/ g.yas ba dan/ gnod sbyin ser po rta ser zhon pa/ g.yas be con/ 'byung po thal skya khyung zhon pa/ g.yas rtse gsum/ 'di thams cad g.yon sdigs mdzub/ sa lha ser po pho rog zhon pa/ g.yas skyabs sbyin g.yon bum pa/ 'jigs byed nag mo drel rta rkang gsum zhon pa/ g.yas khram shing / g.yon nad rkyal/ 'di rnams khro bo'i rnam pa mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gnyis pa mi mgo skam rlon stag sham rus pas brgyan pa/ dbang phyug dkar po glang gdong can glang dmar la zhon pa phyag gnyis rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ lha chen dmar po sbrul gdong can sbrul sngon la zhon nas sbrul zhags kyis dgra 'ching ba/ gshin rje sngon po ma he'i gdong pa can ma he la zhon pa/ g.yas dbyug tho g.yon zhags pa/ gdong drug ser po rma bya'i gdong drug dang ldan pa rma bya la zhon pa/

g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ tshangs pa dmar po ngang pa'i gdong bzhi ngang pa la zhon pa/ phyag gnyis rtse gsum/ bh+riṃ gi ri ti sngo skya rta gdong can rta dmar la zhon pa/ g.yas ral gri/ g.yon thod khrag khyab 'jug nag po khyung gdong can khyung dmar la zhon pa/ phyag gnyis 'khor lo/ tshogs bdag ljang gu glang sna can byi ba la zhon pa/ phyag gnyis la du/ mtha' yas dmar skya/ 'jog po ser/ ka ko tra ṭa nag rigs ldan ljang / nor rgyas ser/ dung skyong dkar/ pad+ma dmar/ pad chen sngo skya rnams smad sbrul mjug stod mi lus sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka gsum bdun gang rung / pa sangs dkar po pad+ma la gnas pa/ g.yas phreng ba g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ mig dmar dmar po ra la zhon pa/ g.yas gri gug g.yon mi mgo za ba/ phur bu dkar po snal dmar zhon pa/ g.yas phreng ba/ g.yon spyi blugs/ nyi ma dmar po rta bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta la gnas pa/ phyag gnyis nyi ma 'dzin pa/ zla ba dkar po ngang ser la zhon pa phyag gnyis zla ba 'dzin pa/ sgra gcan dmar nag khyung sngon la zhon pa/ g.yas nyi ma/ g.yon zla ba/ lhag pa ser po pad dmar la gnas pa/ mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ spen pa ser po sbal ser la gnas pa/ phyag gnyis dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ 'di rnams cung zad khro tshul/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyab can te sde tshan gcig dang / ༈ /yang rlung nag khrod du dbang phyug thal kha 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ thod phreng nag po ral gri 'dzin pa/ bum sna sngon po dgra satwa 'dzin pa/ sen dgu nag po rdo rje 'dzin pa 'di bzhi g.yon sdigs mdzub/ skra brdzes shing thod skam mgo rgyan stag lpags sham thabs/ me tog ma smug nag lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ mdzes ldan ma mthing nag gri gug 'dzin pa/ 'od phreng ma dmar nag mi mgo 'dzin pa/ mdangs 'phrog ma ljang nag rgyu zhags 'dzin pa/ 'di bzhi g.yon thod khrag gzig lpags kyi sham thabs ral ba thur 'phyang ba/

thod skam mgo rgyan/ yab yum bzhi ka'ang shin tu khros pa/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis ro gdan la bzhugs pa rnams sde tshan dang / ༈ /yang me rlung khrod du/ bum bu thal dkar ral gri 'dzin pa/ rnam 'phyang dud kha dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ gyen phreng dmar nag mdung 'dzin pa/ ral gri so nag dgra satwa 'dzin pa/ 'di bzhi g.yon thod pa/ sha za ma smug nag 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ ral pa ma dmar nag mda' 'dzin pa/ gdung ser ma ser po gri gug 'dzin pa/ seng gdong ma mi gdong dkar po rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ 'di bzhi g.yon thod pa/ yab yum brgyad ka mi mgo skam rlon stag sham sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa'i ro gdan la bzhugs pa de rnams sde tshan/ ༈ /yang rlung nag khrod du/ ya ba ti/ mig dmar/ chos rgyal/ cha sang / tel pa/ dmigs pa/ glang mgo ral pa tshar dgu ste pho brgyad sku la mdog sngo skya/ gcer bu/ g.yas ral gri/ g.yon thod khrag ral pa mthur 'phyang / mi mgo sbrul nag rgyu ma'i do shal shin tu khros pa/ ro gdan la g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum gyis bzhugs pa/ lu gu rgyud/ dus mtshan ma/ zhags pa ma/ 'bebs ma/ lcags kyu ma/ pho nya mo/ mche ba mo/ mtshan mo nag mo ste mo brgyad dbu skra dmar nag thur du 'phyang ba/ gzhan sku mdog phyag mtshan bzhugs tshul gdan rnams pho brgyad dang mtshungs de rnams sde tshan/ ༈ /yang sgo 'gram bar mtshams 'os par/ mon pa kha gdangs lag gdengs dang / mon pa gri thogs dang / zhags thogs dang / mda' thogs dang / glu len dang / gri skor gar byed rnams nag po ras thod ang rag dung long rgyu ma'i ga shal bcas pa rnams dang / dge slong / sngags pa/ skyes pa/ bud med de ru 'dren sde bzhi dkyus mtshungs rngam pa/ gzhan yang shongs tshe kha dog cha lugs sna tshogs pa'i 'khor/ la la ba dan g.yab mo/ mi rkang 'bud pa/ zhags pas dgra bgegs 'dzin pa khrag 'thung ba/ spos phor thogs pa/ g.yang gzhi rdeb pa/ thog ser 'bebs pa rnams 'jigs tshul nyams dod pa zhig 'bri dgos kyi tho 'di yang sa skya pa kun blos bris pa'i yi ge pa ni bsod nams 'od zer gyis bgyis pa dge/
